# UnorderedList

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

An unordered list element that displays bulleted items with various bullet styles

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `ListElementBase`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new UnorderedList()
```

## Properties

- [`BulletColor`](#bulletcolor): Color for the bullet character
- [`BulletStyle`](#bulletstyle): Bullet style for the list (Disc, Circle, Square, Dash, Custom)
- [`CustomBullet`](#custombullet): Custom bullet character (only used when BulletStyle is Custom)
- [`Items`](#items): The items in this list (exposed for collection initializer syntax)
